finding_text: Your firm did not conduct a disinfectant efficacy study (DES) based on environmental isolates and materials used specific to your site.

finding_text: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not established and followed.

finding_text: Your visual inspection program is deficient and does not provide adequate assurance that drug products are accurately examined for visible defects.

finding_text: The written stability program is not followed.

finding_text: The batch production and control records are deficient in that they do not include documentation of the accomplishment of each significant step in manufacturing.

finding_text: Drug products were observed stored on the floor of the warehouse and not in a manner that ensures the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug product is not adversely affected.

finding_text: Investigations of an unexplained discrepancy did not extend to other drug products that may have been associated with the specific failure or discrepancy.

finding_text: You exposed sterile drugs and materials to lower than ISO 5 quality air. Specifically, your handling of container-closure system components for Povidone-Iodine Sterile Ophthalmic Solution may result in contamination. During the repackaging process, dropper bottle caps containing the applicator tips are staged (b)(4) on the surface of your ISO 5 laminar flow hood. This practice exposes critical surfaces—specifically, the interior of the dropper bottle cap and the applicator tip—to the non-sterile surface of the ISO 5 hood. Additionally, this (b)(4) The FDA investigator also noted CGMP violations at your facility, that caused your drug products to be adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the FD&C Act. The violations include, for example…
finding_text_ko: 귀사는 무균 의약품과 자재를 ISO 5 미만 등급의 공기에 노출시켰다. 구체적으로, 포비돈 요오드 무균 점안액(Povidone-Iodine Sterile Ophthalmic Solution)의 용기마개 시스템 구성품 취급이 오염을 초래할 수 있다. 재포장 공정 중 도포 팁(applicator tip)이 들어 있는 점안병 마개를 ISO 5 층류 후드(laminar flow hood) 표면 위에 (b)(4) 대기시켜 둔다. 이 관행은 핵심 표면, 즉 점안병 마개 내부와 도포 팁을 후드의 비무균 표면에 노출시킨다. 또한 이 (b)(4) FDA 조사관은 귀사 시설에서 FD&C Act 제501(a)(2)(B)조의 의미에서 의약품을 불량(adulterated)으로 만든 CGMP 위반도 확인했다. 위반사항에는 예를 들어 다음이 포함된다…

finding_text: Subject (b)(6) ’s central CEC density measurement was not completed at Visit 1 (Screening) on August 27, 2024, as required by the protocol. However, this subject was enrolled and received study drug on September 23, 2024.
finding_text_ko: 피험자 (b)(6)의 중심 CEC 밀도 측정이 프로토콜에서 요구한 대로 2024년 8월 27일 방문 1(스크리닝)에서 완료되지 않았다. 그러나 이 피험자는 등록되어 2024년 9월 23일에 시험약을 투여받았다.

finding_text: Fat Mass Reduction:  Findings suggest LGD-4033 may assist in reducing fat mass while preserving lean tissue, making it a focus of studies related to metabolic health.” Your products marketed as SARMs are “new drugs” under section 201(p) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 321(p), because they are not generally recognized as safe and effective (GRASE) for use under the above-described conditions prescribed, recommended, or suggested in their labeling. With certain exceptions not applicable here, a new drug may not be introduced or delivered for introduction into interstate commerce without an approved application from FDA in effect, as described in section 505(a) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 355(a). No approved applications pursuant to section 505 of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 355, are in effect for these products. Accordingly, these products are unapproved new drugs. The introduction or delivery for introduction into interstate commerce of these unapproved new drug products violates sections 301(d) and 505(a) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 331(d) and 355(a).
finding_text_ko: 체지방량 감소: 연구 결과에 따르면 LGD-4033은 제지방(lean tissue)을 보존하면서 체지방량 감소에 도움이 될 수 있어 대사 건강 관련 연구의 초점이 되고 있다." 귀사가 SARMs로 판매하는 제품은 표시에 규정·권고·제안된 위 사용 조건에서 안전하고 유효한 것으로 일반적으로 인정되지(GRASE) 않으므로 FD&C Act 제201(p)조, 21 U.S.C. 321(p)에 따른 "신약(new drugs)"이다. 여기에 해당하지 않는 일부 예외를 제외하고, 신약은 FD&C Act 제505(a)조, 21 U.S.C. 355(a)에 기술된 대로 FDA의 유효한 승인된 신청 없이는 주간(州間) 통상으로 도입되거나 도입 목적으로 인도될 수 없다. 이들 제품에 대해 FD&C Act 제505조, 21 U.S.C. 355에 따른 유효한 승인 신청은 없다. 따라서 이들 제품은 미승인 신약(unapproved new drugs)이다. 이들 미승인 신약 제품을 주간 통상으로 도입하거나 도입 목적으로 인도하는 것은 FD&C Act 제301(d)조 및 제505(a)조, 21 U.S.C. 331(d) 및 355(a)를 위반한다.
